turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: Let's review feedback on the analytics dashboard.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: I grouped the feedback by reporting workflow.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: I brought the latest usability notes from the pilot.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: We should separate ideas from work that someone has accepted.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: That distinction will help when we move this into planning.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: I'll note the suggestions without assigning them prematurely.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: The dashboard review surfaced a few gaps in the weekly view.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: We should add a filter for region.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: It might also help to show the previous period beside the current one.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: Someone could investigate whether the export supports CSV and XLSX.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: A compact mobile summary would be useful too.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: Maybe design could sketch two layout options.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: Those are all reasonable ideas, but nobody has volunteered for them yet.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: Right, I'm not committing to the region filter today.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: And I haven't agreed to produce the mock-ups.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: Let's capture the ideas as proposals for planning.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: We could ask data engineering about the export limitation.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: That is another suggestion, not an assignment.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: Should we rank these before the next planning session?

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: We could rank them, but no one is taking that task now.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: The region filter probably has the clearest user value.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: The comparison view may be more expensive than it sounds.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: We should estimate it before choosing.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: Agreed as a suggestion; no estimate owner is set.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: Let's not turn the discussion into commitments by implication.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: I'll add the ideas to the backlog? No, better: someone can add them during planning.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: That still leaves ownership open.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: Fine. These remain proposals until we assign owners.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: The pilot users mostly asked for faster filtering.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: The export format question depends on the data service.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: We can keep the backlog wording neutral for now.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: No one should read the backlog entry as an acceptance.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: We'll revisit prioritization when owners are assigned.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: That keeps today's ideas at proposal stage.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: I'll carry the proposals into planning without owners.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: No commitments were made today.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: We'll assign owners when the work is prioritized.

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: The export question remains a suggestion.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: I'll leave the backlog entries proposed.

turns.speaker: Jules
turns.text: Thanks, meeting closed.
